messages:
maria g: Heads up — I'm kicking off a quick PoC to ship a joint Datadog dashboard + OpenTelemetry trace enrichment for GPU inference telemetry. Need owners for vetting, an example dashboard JSON, and a short runbook for Marketplace listing. :rocket:

alex k: +1. scope? traces, metrics, logs or all three?

maria g: traces + Datadog infra metrics (GPU util, memory, NVLink) + prefix-based span tagging. logs later.

jeff p: Proposed KPIs: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, cache hit rate, GPU util, OOM events. Also add end-to-end span duration for the `generate` op.

rami infra: I'll wire an OTLP exporter to our sidecar. snippet: 
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  logging:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "${DD_API_KEY}"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

jen s: For Marketplace we need a one-page integration README + dashboard JSON + sample alert rules. I can draft the README and an example alert bundle.

alex k: Who owns dashboard JSON? can we reuse Datadog's GPU template as a base and layer span widgets?

maria g: @alex k + @rami infra to own dashboard. Jeff will define KPIs. Jen will own Marketplace assets. I'll own announcement cadence with Partners.

datadog-ops-bot: New integration ticket created: DD-INT-5423 — https://tracker.company/DD-INT-5423

sarah cs: From CS POV, include a 'how it helps customers' blurb — e.g., reduce tail latency by routing to dedicated pools when cache-hit < 70%.

rami infra: small note — we need to ensure traces are tagged with model_id and quantization_profile to make dashboards filterable; otherwise dashboards are noisy.

jeff p: alert ideas: GPU_throttled > 5% for 5m, p95_latency > 2s for 10m, cache_hit_rate < 60% => page. Also a non-critical warning for token generation stalls.

maria g: timeline proposal: PoC infra + dashboard draft by EOD next Fri (1842700000), review + docs the following week. Anybody blocked?

alex k: blocked by Datadog API key for a test account — @jen s can you request a scoped test key for the integration env?

jen s: filed request with infra-keys. should have test key by tomorrow morning.

maria g: Great. I'll add a tiny runbook for SSO/KMS concerns and permissioning for Private deployments (VPC & on-prem).

rami infra: quick config for span enrichment (env var):
```
REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true
TRACE_TAGS=model_id,quant_profile,customer_id
```

alex k: ok launching PoC infra now. Will post link to dashboard JSON once ready. :eyes:

maria g: thx all. I'll book a 30m sync for Wed 9am PT. Invite sent. :calendar:

jen s: +1

sarah cs: +1 :thumbsup:

maria g: (closing) Action items summarized in DD-INT-5423. Ping me if anything slips.
